US.logoExplainer: Seal of the United States Federal Reserve System: a circular black-and-white device with an eagle above a striped shield, olive branch and arrows, ringed by the legend "UNITED STATES · FEDERAL RESERVE SYSTEM". This is the System's official cognisance — not a Federal Reserve Note plate seal.
